{{Quote|We have made life.|An Arkanian re-engineering scientist to Vaskau Farg|<ref name="Arkanian Chill">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030206arkanianintro|text=Arkanian Chill|int=Arkanian Chill}}</ref>}}
'''Re-engineering''' was a process of [[Bioengineering/Legends|genetic engineering]] employed by the corporation [[Arkanian Microtechnologies]] to make both [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] and non-sentient beings stronger, more docile, and less intelligent. In the process, the subjects also gained a strange [[The Force/Legends|Force]] signature that made them feel "wrong" or unnatural to [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]], and which made them frighten non-sentient creatures, such as [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]]. The [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Findsman/Legends|Findsman]] [[Vaskau Farg]] encountered several re-engineering subjects in an [[Unidentified Arkanian Microtechnologies installation|Arkanian Microtechnologies facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]] while trying to claim a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on a [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] [[Unidentified Sakiyan scientist|scientist]]&mdash;a "[[Witch/Legends|witch]]" to him&mdash;who was consulting on the project.
